question: Does the existing evidence distinguish overload relief from reserve improvement as purposes of same-station completion?
scope: Descriptive analysis of saved feedback and previously audited closed-loop comparisons only. No new trigger policy, simulations, training, parameter search or timing claim.
primary_states: 179 actual FRAME calls from old13/G1/G2; 185 FULL calls are a separate diagnostic population, not additional independent samples.
threshold_origins: 1 is the rated loading ratio; 0.9 is the unchanged historical controller/search setting. Neither is tuned here. These are candidate+base one-step forecasts, not final controlled-state or future-safety certificates.
outcomes: completion calls, queries and measured forecast seconds
strict reward improvement using inherited diagnostic tolerance 1e-6
exact chosen-ID changes including float32 ties
equal-query local versus next-global expansion on FULL states
stratification of the rejected station-support veto
first actual closed-loop action divergence and complete-week cost direction
inference_limits: Post-hoc exposed-state characterization. No causal or out-of-sample trigger validation; gains in max-rho proxy do not establish economic gains. Do not pool correlated calls as independent scenarios. No cost threshold or new acceptance rule is selected. No independent AC re-solve.
